meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 这项技能让 Claude 能操作 DNAnexus 云平台：创建和部署应用(app/applet)，上传下载文件，运行和监控基因组分析作业，编写 dxpy Python 脚本，并配置 dxapp.json 和依赖。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或修改 DNAnexus 应用、上传下载或搜索数据文件、运行和监控分析作业时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 dxpy 上传 sample.fastq 到 project-xxxx
写一个 dxapp.json，输入 FASTQ，输出 BAM
运行这个 applet，等待结果并下载输出
say.note: Claude 会监控作业并处理输出

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude operate the DNAnexus cloud genomics platform: build and deploy apps/applets, upload/download files, run and monitor genome analysis jobs, write dxpy Python scripts, and configure dxapp.json and dependencies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build or modify a DNAnexus app/applet, upload/download/search data files, run and monitor analysis jobs, or write dxpy scripts.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project-xxxx using dxpy
Create a dxapp.json with FASTQ input and BAM output
say_en.note: Claude will generate the config file

say_en.text: Run this applet, wait for completion, download output
say_en.note: Claude will monitor the job and handle output
